data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-fra3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=JQqpBnVwYisQ7kNvgHFVwOc&_nc_ht=scontent-fra3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDAS1_ML__ROQg3jTDqt1WqsMO5OF3dFY3IkaVVogtFVA&oe=671CD31C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-fra3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=qnKK-4Jq4rYQ7kNvgF5ECxO&_nc_ht=scontent-fra3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAh8zrmwGiBYTpsrAn9efqUit1B7KHGZjEApyuctEeyUg&oe=671CDCA4)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-fra3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=2dNm1fOCB9IQ7kNvgFItkfV&_nc_ht=scontent-fra3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDVzUkZXTSeJWzvJC8Y74aNcYBfbaneWhM_xMJIailcog&oe=671CC407)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-fra5-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=xH5K-cakXroQ7kNvgGvMnrl&_nc_ht=scontent-fra5-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCxi-5vRcWdKg6flPxVc7JL2BjPzNtvctEZuKyDnbqpiw&oe=671CB6E6)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-fra3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=twtsgMiq_uQQ7kNvgFIk8H5&_nc_ht=scontent-fra3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBddD7FYzORc--CKIttwZtDXXl1rGSG8Sih2fK1bDMMhg&oe=671CE358)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-fra3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=Ef3kfL8a-zIQ7kNvgF_dQqK&_nc_ht=scontent-fra3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCt86UBPiQj13CRnQGjPU6gMYGt2pMsf-BOhUjGt28AyQ&oe=671CDFD9)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-fra5-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=IzQXeDCjf0gQ7kNvgEDqLxm&_nc_ht=scontent-fra5-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAkA9XW3ucBKpy-gEzJ7-t7V-6Ol_1os0IZZiXkLGtoGQ&oe=671CC5F0)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-fra5-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=JucPrYtS-YsQ7kNvgH8vULQ&_nc_ht=scontent-fra5-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDhHu5qUgKe7rfDhIC1PCUZEoM4ySTJvajJO_eZCbxBGg&oe=671CE8AA)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-fra3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=gPZUkeRwbWwQ7kNvgHBrQxX&_nc_ht=scontent-fra3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCvc_SfCo7oht0GciWoSb1f3jQpRhGOigOb0kY7X5g1Gg&oe=671CC417)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-fra3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=DDDhFxZD6I0Q7kNvgHXfL5o&_nc_ht=scontent-fra3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYD5rWH6WX6lyMqHOC5ecsMg6LdKWm9w902qkMkYxDYvkw&oe=671CDF8C)
